value.stringValue: First segment continues from prior batch, but no stored OPEN segment ends exactly at start-1 with matching type. Persist earlier batches first.

value.stringValue: Line must be seven-field, valid category, contiguous indexes, non-PENDING topic/summary, continuity flags only at batch edges.

value.stringValue: Check source permissions, start character and max characters; this Flow requires the same batching inputs as Enrichment.
Segment or merged segment exceeds safety threshold of 32000 characters. Split or enlarge Salesforce field first.

value.stringValue: Preceding batch has an OPEN segment, but first approved boundary says from_previous=false. Correct approval first.
